finalText:
Build green. Exit 0.

Two real bugs, both from bump, sequential — second hid behind first:

**1. `src/core/options.js:7`** — options shape renamed `retries` to `retryCount`. This call site missed it, so `options.retries` undefined, `.toFixed()` threw. Now reads new name, falls back to old, defaults 0.

**2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8`** — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, old one returned `false`. Strict check threw on `undefined`. Now `undefined` maps to `false` (old default); other non-booleans still error.

Warnings: 8 remain, all noise — `build.js` prints them unconditionally from a hardcoded list (lines 18-24, 46-48). They name files that do not exist in this tree (`src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js`, `src/core/graph.js`). Nothing to fix in source; silencing them means editing the bundler's own warning list. Say word if you want that.
